claim: Argentina legislated these terms (INV Resolution C.32/2011)
because: The resolution that defines Reserva and Gran Reserva is INV Resolución C.11, dated 11 March 2011, which amended C.20/04 and repealed C.22/2008. It was later amended by Resolución 26/2021.
